verses.original: Τὸν δὲ ἀσθενοῦντα τῇ πίστει προσλαμβάνεσθε μὴ εἰς διακρίσεις διαλογισμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ton de asthenounta tē pistei proslambanesthe mē eis diakriseis dialogismōn
verses.literal: Accept him whose faith is weak without . . . passing judgment on his opinions
verses.literalPt: Mas acolhei o que é fraco na sua fé, não para discutir as suas dúvidas.

verses.original: ὃς μὲν πιστεύει φαγεῖν πάντα ὁ δὲ ἀσθενῶν λάχανα ἐσθίει
verses.transliteration: hos men pisteuei phagein panta ho de asthenōn lachana esthiei
verses.literal: For one person has faith to eat all things while another who is weak eats only vegetables
verses.literalPt: Um crê que pode comer de tudo, mas o que é fraco come legumes.

verses.original: ὁ ἐσθίων τὸν μὴ ἐσθίοντα μὴ ἐξουθενείτω ὁ δὲ μὴ ἐσθίων τὸν ἐσθίοντα μὴ κρινέτω ὁ Θεὸς γὰρ αὐτὸν προσελάβετο
verses.transliteration: ho esthiōn ton mē esthionta mē exoutheneitō ho de mē esthiōn ton esthionta mē krinetō ho Theos gar auton proselabeto
verses.literal: The one who eats everything must not belittle the one who does not and the one who does not eat everything must not judge the one who does for God has accepted him
verses.literalPt: Quem come não despreze àquele que não come; e quem não come não julgue àquele que come, porque Deus o acolheu.

verses.original: σὺ τίς εἶ ὁ κρίνων ἀλλότριον οἰκέτην τῷ ἰδίῳ κυρίῳ στήκει ἢ πίπτει σταθήσεται δέ δυνατεῖ γὰρ ὁ Κύριος στῆσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: sy tis ei ho krinōn allotrion oiketēn tō idiō kyriō stēkei ē piptei stathēsetai de dynatei gar ho Kyrios stēsai auton
verses.literal: Who are you to judge someone else’s servant To his own master he stands or falls And he will stand for the Lord is able to make him stand
verses.literalPt: Quem és tu que julgas o servo alheio? Para o seu próprio amo está em pé ou cai; mas ele estará firme, porque poderoso é o Senhor para o firmar.

verses.original: Ὃς μὲν γὰρ κρίνει ἡμέραν παρ’ ἡμέραν ὃς δὲ κρίνει πᾶσαν ἡμέραν ἕκαστος ἐν τῷ ἰδίῳ νοῒ πληροφορείσθω
verses.transliteration: Hos men gar krinei hēmeran par’ hēmeran hos de krinei pasan hēmeran hekastos en tō idiō noi plērophoreisthō
verses.literal: One person regards a certain day above the others while someone else considers every day alike Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind
verses.literalPt: Um avalia um dia mais que outro dia; outro avalia todos os dias iguais; esteja cada um plenamente convencido em sua mente.

verses.original: ὁ φρονῶν τὴν ἡμέραν Κυρίῳ φρονεῖ ὁ ἐσθίων Κυρίῳ ἐσθίει εὐχαριστεῖ γὰρ τῷ Θεῷ καὶ ὁ μὴ ἐσθίων Κυρίῳ οὐκ ἐσθίει καὶ εὐχαριστεῖ τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: ho phronōn tēn hēmeran Kyriō phronei ho esthiōn Kyriō esthiei eucharistei gar tō Theō kai ho mē esthiōn Kyriō ouk esthiei kai eucharistei tō Theō
verses.literal: He who observes a special day does so to the Lord he who eats does so to the Lord for he gives thanks to God and he who abstains does so to the Lord and gives thanks to God
verses.literalPt: Quem distingue o dia para o Senhor o distingue; e quem come para o Senhor come, porque dá graças a Deus; e quem não come para o Senhor não come e dá graças a Deus.

verses.original: Οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἡμῶν ἑαυτῷ ζῇ καὶ οὐδεὶς ἑαυτῷ ἀποθνῄσκει
verses.transliteration: Oudeis gar hēmōn heautō zē kai oudeis heautō apothnēskei
verses.literal: For none of us lives to himself alone and none of us dies to himself alone
verses.literalPt: Pois nenhum de nós vive para si e nenhum de nós morre para si;

verses.original: ἐάν τε γὰρ ζῶμεν τῷ Κυρίῳ ζῶμεν ἐάν τε ἀποθνήσκωμεν τῷ Κυρίῳ ἀποθνήσκομεν ἐάν τε οὖν ζῶμεν ἐάν τε ἀποθνήσκωμεν τοῦ Κυρίου ἐσμέν
verses.transliteration: ean te gar zōmen tō Kyriō zōmen ean te apothnēskōmen tō Kyriō apothnēskomen ean te oun zōmen ean te apothnēskōmen tou Kyriou esmen
verses.literal: If we live we live to the Lord and if we die we die to the Lord So whether we live or die we belong to the Lord
verses.literalPt: se vivermos, para o Senhor vivemos; e, se morrermos, para o Senhor morremos. Quer, pois, vivamos ou morramos, somos do Senhor.

verses.original: εἰς τοῦτο γὰρ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἔζησεν ἵνα καὶ νεκρῶν καὶ ζώντων κυριεύσῃ
verses.transliteration: eis touto gar Christos apethanen kai ezēsen hina kai nekrōn kai zōntōn kyrieusē
verses.literal: For this reason . . . Christ died and returned to life that He might be the Lord of both the dead and the living
verses.literalPt: Pois para isso é que Cristo morreu e tornou a viver, para que fosse Senhor tanto de mortos como de vivos.

verses.original: Σὺ δὲ τί κρίνεις τὸν ἀδελφόν σου ἢ καὶ σὺ τί ἐξουθενεῖς τὸν ἀδελφόν σου πάντες γὰρ παραστησόμεθα τῷ βήματι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Sy de ti krineis ton adelphon sou ē kai sy ti exoutheneis ton adelphon sou pantes gar parastēsometha tō bēmati tou Theou
verses.literal: Why then do you judge your brother Or why do you belittle your brother For we will all stand before God’s judgment seat
verses.literalPt: Tu, porém, por que julgas a teu irmão? Ou tu também, por que desprezas a teu irmão? Pois todos compareceremos perante o tribunal de Deus.

verses.original: γέγραπται γάρ Ζῶ ἐγώ λέγει Κύριος ὅτι ἐμοὶ κάμψει πᾶν γόνυ καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσεται τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: gegraptai gar Zō egō legei Kyrios hoti emoi kampsei pan gony kai pasa glōssa exomologēsetai tō Theō
verses.literal: It is written As surely as I live says the Lord every knee will bow before Me every tongue will confess to God
verses.literalPt: Pois está escrito: Por minha vida, diz o Senhor, diante de mim se dobrará todo joelho, E toda língua glorificará a Deus.

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν ἕκαστος ἡμῶν περὶ ἑαυτοῦ λόγον δώσει τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: Ara oun hekastos hēmōn peri heautou logon dōsei tō Theō
verses.literal: So then each of us will give an account of himself to God
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, cada um de nós dará conta de si mesmo a Deus.

verses.original: Μηκέτι οὖν ἀλλήλους κρίνωμεν ἀλλὰ τοῦτο κρίνατε μᾶλλον τὸ μὴ τιθέναι πρόσκομμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ ἢ σκάνδαλον
verses.transliteration: Mēketi oun allēlous krinōmen alla touto krinate mallon to mē tithenai proskomma tō adelphō ē skandalon
verses.literal: Therefore let us stop judging one another Instead . . . make up your mind not to put any stumbling block or obstacle in your brother’s way
verses.literalPt: Portanto, não nos julguemos mais uns aos outros; mas, antes, decidi isto em não pordes tropeço ou escândalo ao vosso irmão.

verses.original: Οἶδα καὶ πέπεισμαι ἐν Κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ ὅτι οὐδὲν κοινὸν δι’ ἑαυτοῦ εἰ μὴ τῷ λογιζομένῳ τι κοινὸν εἶναι ἐκείνῳ κοινόν
verses.transliteration: Oida kai pepeismai en Kyriō Iēsou hoti ouden koinon di’ heautou ei mē tō logizomenō ti koinon einai ekeinō koinon
verses.literal: I am convinced and fully persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself But if . . . anyone regards something as unclean then for him it is unclean
verses.literalPt: Eu sei e estou persuadido no Senhor Jesus que nenhuma coisa é em si impura, a não ser para aquele que a tem como tal; para este é ela impura.

verses.original: εἰ γὰρ διὰ βρῶμα ὁ ἀδελφός σου λυπεῖται οὐκέτι κατὰ ἀγάπην περιπατεῖς μὴ τῷ βρώματί σου ἐκεῖνον ἀπόλλυε ὑπὲρ οὗ Χριστὸς ἀπέθανεν
verses.transliteration: ei gar dia brōma ho adelphos sou lypeitai ouketi kata agapēn peripateis mē tō brōmati sou ekeinon apollye hyper hou Christos apethanen
verses.literal: If your brother is distressed by what you eat you are no longer acting in love Do not by your eating destroy your brother for whom Christ died
verses.literalPt: Se, por causa da comida, o teu irmão se entristece, já não andas segundo a caridade. Não faças perecer pela tua comida aquele por quem Cristo morreu.

verses.original: Μὴ βλασφημείσθω οὖν ὑμῶν τὸ ἀγαθόν
verses.transliteration: Mē blasphēmeisthō oun hymōn to agathon
verses.literal: Do not allow what you consider good then to be spoken of as evil
verses.literalPt: Não seja, pois, censurado o vosso bem.

verses.original: οὐ γάρ ἐστιν ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ βρῶσις καὶ πόσις ἀλλὰ δικαιοσύνη καὶ εἰρήνη καὶ χαρὰ ἐν Πνεύματι Ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: ou gar estin hē basileia tou Theou brōsis kai posis alla dikaiosynē kai eirēnē kai chara en Pneumati Hagiō
verses.literal: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking but of righteousness peace and joy in the Holy Spirit
verses.literalPt: Pois o reino de Deus não é comer, nem beber, mas justiça, paz e gozo no Espírito Santo;

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ ἐν τούτῳ δουλεύων τῷ Χριστῷ εὐάρεστος τῷ Θεῷ καὶ δόκιμος τοῖς ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: ho gar en toutō douleuōn tō Christō euarestos tō Theō kai dokimos tois anthrōpois
verses.literal: For whoever serves Christ in this way is pleasing to God and approved by men
verses.literalPt: porque quem nisso serve a Cristo é agradável a Deus e aprovado dos homens.

verses.original: Ἄρα οὖν τὰ τῆς εἰρήνης διώκωμεν καὶ τὰ τῆς οἰκοδομῆς τῆς εἰς ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: Ara oun ta tēs eirēnēs diōkōmen kai ta tēs oikodomēs tēs eis allēlous
verses.literal: So then let us pursue what leads to peace and to mutual edification
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, seguimos as coisas que contribuem para a paz e as que são para a edificação mútua.

verses.original: μὴ ἕνεκεν βρώματος κατάλυε τὸ ἔργον τοῦ Θεοῦ πάντα μὲν καθαρά ἀλλὰ κακὸν τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ τῷ διὰ προσκόμματος ἐσθίοντι
verses.transliteration: mē heneken brōmatos katalye to ergon tou Theou panta men kathara alla kakon tō anthrōpō tō dia proskommatos esthionti
verses.literal: Do not destroy the work of God for the sake of food All food is clean but it is wrong for a man to let his eating be a stumbling block
verses.literalPt: Não destruas a obra de Deus por causa da comida. Todas as coisas, na verdade, são limpas, porém são más para o homem que come com ofensa.

verses.original: καλὸν τὸ μὴ φαγεῖν κρέα μηδὲ πιεῖν οἶνον μηδὲ ἐν ᾧ ὁ ἀδελφός σου προσκόπτει
verses.transliteration: kalon to mē phagein krea mēde piein oinon mēde en hō ho adelphos sou proskoptei
verses.literal: It is better not to eat meat or drink wine or to do anything to cause your brother to stumble
verses.literalPt: Bom é não comer carne, nem beber vinho, nem fazer alguma coisa em que teu irmão ache tropeço.

verses.original: Σὺ πίστιν ἣν ἔχεις κατὰ σεαυτὸν ἔχε ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ μακάριος ὁ μὴ κρίνων ἑαυτὸν ἐν ᾧ δοκιμάζει
verses.transliteration: Sy pistin hēn echeis kata seauton eche enōpion tou Theou makarios ho mē krinōn heauton en hō dokimazei
verses.literal: Keep your belief about such matters . . . between yourself and God Blessed is the one who does not condemn himself by what he approves
verses.literalPt: A fé que tu tens, guarda-a para ti mesmo diante de Deus. Bem-aventurado é aquele que não se condena naquilo que aprova.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ διακρινόμενος ἐὰν φάγῃ κατακέκριται ὅτι οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως πᾶν δὲ ὃ οὐκ ἐκ πίστεως ἁμαρτία ἐστίν
verses.transliteration: ho de diakrinomenos ean phagē katakekritai hoti ouk ek pisteōs pan de ho ouk ek pisteōs hamartia estin
verses.literal: But the one who has doubts is condemned if he eats because his eating is not from faith and everything that is not from faith is sin
verses.literalPt: Mas aquele que duvida é condenado se comer, pois o que faz não é proveniente da fé; e tudo o que não provém da fé é pecado.
